newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Uganda President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni would meet Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro on Tuesday. He said they would meet reporters in the Breydel VIP Corner around 0930/0730 GMT.

In answer to a question, spokesman Patrick Child said Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy would present before the European Parliament documents on the economic forecasts, the Commission recommendations for great economic orientations and the external aspects of the euro on Wednesday. He said de Silguy would hold a news conference afterwoods, around 1215/1015 GMT, in the Breydel news room.
Asked which countries besides Britain were facing "euroscepticism", van der Pas said there was an increasing amount of member states having to face this problem.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/319: ECU 12 million for cross-border cooperation between Austria and Italy.
- Speech/97/89: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer - "A message for the sceptics" at the Sicco L. Mansholt Lecture 1997.
- Speech/97/90: Speech by Commissioner Edith Cresson - "Towards a European comon house in the field of education: from assistance to cooperation."
- Speech/97/91: Speech by Commissioner Mario Monti on "the action plan and the accounting priorities" at the annual dinner of the Institute of Chartered Accountants.
- Speech/97/92: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "the Euro and business: preparing for action".
- Speech/97/93: Speech by Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard at the launching of the EU-PHARE eduction programme - "creating greater public awareness".
